parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action specified in the rule. Valid values:

*   **1**: alert
*   **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule.

>  You can call the [ListContainerDefenseRule](~~2590599~~) operation to query the IDs of rules.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

*   1: system rule
*   2: custom rule

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The effective scope of the rule.
